captured_original.record_join: Within each map, join decoded record offset to record_code_associations.location.record_offset and library_index. Twenty associations (four each for 63205..63209) have decoded vt_feedback_buffer base_index=7, resource_count=1. All five are pixel shaders.
captured_original.descriptor: Each corresponding reflected SPIR-V has one D3D uav space 0 index 7, uint32 storage texel buffer (VkDescriptorType 5), no resource-table entries; mapped descriptor binding is 7 for 63206 and 11 for the others.
captured_original.d3d_wrapper: Each original D3D wrapper has an empty UAV resource table and packed uavs count 8. Count is register extent, not eight independently proven descriptors.
captured_original.caveat: The original constructor establishes the parameter name, but these captures do not establish the renderer binding function or independently join that named allocation to the decoded u7 record.
captured_original.original_parameter_name: VTFeedbackBuffer: original material shader constructors at 0x143509060 and 0x1435091c0 call 0x143a822e0 with that name and the parameter map. Captures: porting/generated/apollo-material-evidence/terrain-uniform-initializers/0x143509060.c and 0x1435091c0.c.

serialization_comparison.native_fields: Param(true) reads two uint16 fields BaseIndex and Size (Size means resource count here), leaves BufferIndex at its default 0; no BufferIndex is serialized in this path.
serialization_comparison.ue426_contract: FShaderResourceParameter::Bind passes an unused local buffer index to FindParameterAllocation and uses BaseIndex and NumResources; operator<< serializes those two fields. This is source analogy, not captured original serializer.

current_engine.facts: Current View uniform parameters contain UAV RWBuffer<uint> VTFeedbackBuffer, populated from scene feedback; base pass shader uses View.VTFeedbackBuffer. MaterialShader.h retains a historical comment saying its resource parameter is only for unbound error and UAV binds with render targets; UE 4.26 FMaterialShader constructor and GetShaderBindings do not bind that field. Do not assume this comment describes the original or the current Vulkan path.
current_engine.vulkan_ub_path: VulkanCommands UBMT_UAV uses FUBResourceInfo.SourceUBResourceIndex to read the actual bound UB resource and GlobalIndex to find the global descriptor remap. A buffer-view UAV is written as a texel-buffer view by SetUAVForUBResource.
current_engine.direct_path: RHISetUAVParameter on a pixel shader delegates to SetUAVForStage, which resolves a Vulkan Global parameter index, not a D3D register number.

vulkan_header_requirements.facts: A Vulkan global has OriginalBindingIndex, descriptor type index, no combined sampler alias, and corresponding GlobalSpirvInfos descriptor-set and binding word offsets. Compiler remaps a named global allocation to BufferIndex=FVulkanShaderHeader::Global, BaseIndex=header global index, Size=count, original parameter type; direct graphics UAV writes consume that global index. OriginalBindingIndex is the converted SPIR-V binding, not necessarily the original D3D u7.

next_dependency: Establish the original renderer binding path or independently verify an equivalent target runtime View UAV mapping and resource layout; then construct and validate the descriptor and binding. Do not treat a synthetic View resource as an original D3D resource-table entry.
